headline: Videocon Industries Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Videocon Industries Limited, the consumer electronics and home appliances conglomerate, has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company notified the NSE of the commencement via intimation to the stock exchange.
detail: Videocon Industries, a listed company on NSE and BSE with operations spanning consumer durables, real estate and financial services, has formally initiated CIRP proceedings, likely upon an application by a creditor or the company itself to the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). The NSE intimation dated 22 June 2026 signals the commencement of the statutory resolution process. During CIRP, an Insolvency Resolution Professional (IRP) will manage the company's affairs, prepare an Information Memorandum, invite resolution plans from qualified bidders, and the Committee of Creditors (CoC) will evaluate and vote on proposals, with the goal of either restoring the company as a going concern or maximizing asset realization.
